verdict.rationale: Alloy documents ongoing screening: workflows can run on a schedule as Portfolio workflows, and it markets continuous portfolio monitoring and perpetual KYC/AML. However, nothing shows a compliance officer turning that screening on or off for selected customers. The only documented enablement is per event type (mapping to a Source Workflow), not per customer. missing for 10: a documented per-customer enable/disable control for ongoing screening, a dashboard or API way to select which customers are enrolled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can enable and disable ongoing screening for selected customers
